2609.01106.title: Hints Help But Do They Teach? Evaluating Skills Transfer in Code Generation
2609.01106.paper_summary: When a hint turns a failing generated program into a passing one, does it provide missing information or merely steer the model toward a solution it could already produce? We test these hypotheses on HumanEval+ and MBPP+ using executable evaluation. For Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, adaptive relevant hints rescue 36 of 79 selected failures; an unrelated hint rescues 19, while eight unhinted samples solve 46 and recover 31 of the 36 relevant-hint rescues. Phi-3.5-mini shows the same pattern: relevant hints rescue 42 of 101 failures, an unrelated hint rescues 17, and unhinted sampling solves 57, including 36 of the 42 relevant-hint rescues. Because the hint conditions use different attempt budgets, these comparisons do not isolate a purely semantic effect. Mechanistic tests on Qwen identify a stable activation direction shared by relevant and unrelated hints. Persistently adding this direction yields 14 rescues and 18 regressions, with no detectable net accuracy gain; learned low-rank interventions have a positive but imprecise estimated effect. Full textual specifications solve 22 of 24 context-defined problems, versus 5-11 for tested virtual-KV prefixes. Post-generation hidden-state probes transfer across benchmarks, with pooled AUROC 0.806 and 0.780, but their top-one selection advantage over token confidence is statistically unresolved. Overall, relevant hints can rescue failures, but most rescued solutions are already reachable through ordinary sampling, and the internal interventions tested here do not establish task-general capability transfer.
2609.01106.paper_summary_zh: 當一個提示將一個失敗的生成程式轉變為成功的程式時，它是提供了缺失的信息，還是僅僅引導模型朝向它已經能夠產出的解決方案？我們在 HumanEval+ 和 MBPP+ 上使用可執行評估來測試這些假設。對於 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct，適應性相關提示救回了 79 個選定失敗中的 36 個；一個無關的提示救回了 19 個，而八個未提示的樣本解決了 46 個，並恢復了 36 個相關提示救回的 31 個。Phi-3.5-mini 顯示出相同的模式：相關提示救回了 101 個失敗中的 42 個，一個無關的提示救回了 17 個，而未提示的抽樣解決了 57 個，包括 42 個相關提示救回的 36 個。由於提示條件使用不同的嘗試預算，這些比較並未孤立出純粹的語義效應。對 Qwen 的機械測試識別出一個由相關和無關提示共享的穩定激活方向。持續添加這個方向產生了 14 次救回和 18 次回歸，沒有檢測到淨準確度的增益；學習的低秩干預具有正面但不精確的估計效果。完整的文本規範解決了 24 個上下文定義問題中的 22 個，而測試的虛擬-KV 前綴則解決了 5-11 個。生成後的隱藏狀態探測在基準之間轉移，合併的 AUROC 為 0.806 和 0.780，但它們在標記信心上的 top-one 選擇優勢在統計上未解決。總的來說，相關提示可以救回失敗，但大多數被救回的解決方案已經可以通過普通抽樣達到，而這裡測試的內部干預並未建立任務通用的能力轉移。
